layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_mode: MODE A: TETRIS GRID (Asymmetrical Editorial Grid for Portfolio & Services)
rules: Generous spacing: use py-20 to py-32 for section breathing room.
Never crowd photo cards; let negative space frame each visual piece.
Subtle 1px border with 15% opacity gold (rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15)) on cards.
Containers with borders must have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.
No full screen flat text overlay. Use gradient fade from black/80 to transparent.

visual_enhancers.botanical_decorations: Subtle low-opacity SVG floral/botanical leaf vector outlines floating softly in background corners (opacity 0.04 to 0.08 in gold/zinc).
visual_enhancers.gold_lines: 1px horizontal and vertical accent dividers in rgba(212,175,55,0.25) with soft shimmer animation.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70 border border-amber-500/10 for sticky headers, floating WhatsApp CTA, and lightbox overlays.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Smooth 0.3s ease transitions, slow image hover zoom (scale-105), soft gold outer glow on focus/hover (shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)]).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Dutch locale throughout the UI ('Boek Nu', 'Onze Diensten', 'Contact Opnemen', 'Offerte Aanvragen').
Implement Lenis or smooth scroll behavior for an ultra-premium studio feel.
Avoid tacky heavy gold gradients; use gold as 1px borders, subtle icon glows, and elegant typography accents.
Include floating WhatsApp button at bottom right (data-testid='floating-whatsapp-button').
Ensure interactive Lightbox modal opens when clicking any portfolio item.
Build backend API endpoints in backend/server.py for storing bookings, contact messages, and admin authentication.
